auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on (i) write-off of inventories aggregating to ₹415.82 lakhs during the year ended March 31, 2026, and (ii) lease arrangement with a related party for factory premises with reduced lease rentals and proposed sale under discussion.

key_risks: Provisions for taxation, litigation, and other significant provisions requiring management judgements and estimates
Assessment of contingent liabilities relating to litigations and claims

facts.related_party_note: Lease arrangement with related party for factory premises; during the year, with effect from April 1, 2025, the Company significantly reduced lease rentals payable by the related party tenant, considered in conjunction with an increase in security deposit received, and proposed sale of the factory premises to the tenant is under discussion. Loan to Parcos Brands Private Limited (enterprise over which directors have significant influence) was outstanding ₹1.85 crore as on 31st March 2025, nil as on 31st March 2026. Unsecured loan from a director repaid ₹13.75 lakh during the year, outstanding balance ₹67.34 lakh as on 31st March 2026.
